lines: Logic weaves through the dark void,
Green leaves dance upon the breeze,
Autumn leaves dance in the dark,
Snowflakes drift from gray skies down,
Snow falls gently on the ground
Moonlight paints the world in white,
Stars whisper secrets to the moon,
A new day's promise, fresh start,
Raindrops kiss the old tin roof—
Dappled light through oak leaves sways
Painting clouds in shades of red,
Leaves drink deep beneath moonlight's glow
Leaves drift on amber air soft
Whispers through the pine trees sigh
Birds sing sweetly in the trees
Soft winds carry petals across the path,
on the still pond's green surface
